who: Jiro Ono · Jiro Dreams of Sushi, 2011
quote: I do the same thing over and over, improving bit by bit. There is always a yearning to achieve more.
meaning: Sushi chef Jiro Ono, 85 in the film, makes the same sushi every day and gets a little better each time.

who: Hitopadesha · The Book of Good Counsels, tr. Edwin Arnold, 1861
quote: Drops of water falling, falling, falling, brim the chatty o'er; Wisdom comes in little lessons--little gains make largest store.
meaning: Many small drops fill a pot. Many small lessons, done again and again, slowly add up to real wisdom.

who: Hillel · Babylonian Talmud, Chagigah 9b, c. 500 CE
quote: One who reviews his studies one hundred times is not comparable to one who reviews his studies one hundred and one times.
meaning: Doing it one more time still matters. The person who practices 101 times is ahead of the one who stopped at 100.

quote: I studied and worked at them every day for the next twelve years.
meaning: At 13 Casals found Bach's cello suites, then practiced them every day for 12 years before playing one in public.

who: John Locke · Of the Conduct of the Understanding, 1706
quote: Nobody is made anything by hearing of rules or laying them up in his memory; practice must settle the habit of doing without reflecting on the rule.
meaning: Hearing rules teaches no skill. Only practice, again and again, makes it happen without thinking. Locke's book came out in 1706.

who: Maria Montessori · Spontaneous Activity in Education, 1917
quote: I counted forty-four repetitions; when at last she ceased... she looked round with a satisfied air, almost as if awaking from a refreshing nap.
meaning: Doctor Maria Montessori watched a girl of about 3 repeat one task 44 times, then finish calm and happy.

who: William James · The Principles of Psychology, 1890
quote: If he keep faithfully busy each hour of the working-day, he may safely leave the final result to itself.
meaning: Keep doing the work hour after hour, day after day. The skill grows by itself, so you can stop worrying.

quote: Don't undermine the work I've put in every day. Not some days. Every day.
meaning: In 2011 Ray Allen broke the NBA record for most three-pointers by practicing every day, not by talent alone.

quote: A habit is a firmly rooted quality acquired by doing a certain action and repeating it time after time, until the form of (that action) is firmly fixed.
meaning: In 1377 Ibn Khaldun wrote that doing the same action again and again makes it a firm habit.

who: Haruki Murakami · The Paris Review interview, 2004
quote: I keep to this routine every day without variation. The repetition itself becomes the important thing; it's a form of mesmerism.
meaning: Murakami wakes at 4 a.m. and runs 10 km or swims. Doing the same each day helps his mind go deep.
